text:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty → prod-latency triggered (PD#12345) — page fired :rotating_light: link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD12345
Ava L: acked — oncall taking a look. will grab metrics + check canaries.
Ravi P: seeing a very short-lived spike on proxy-router (p95 ~ 420ms -> 2s) at 14:02 UTC, then dropped back. no error rate bump. looks noisy.
Jordan C: support dashboards show no user-facing errors, requests/sec steady. no customer tickets.
Ava L: running quick checks:
```
# tail last 200 lines of canary job logs
kubectl -n monitoring logs job/canary-run-2026-03-15 --tail=200
# query short window latencies
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?expr=histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le))"
```
Ravi P: log snippet from the canary job: `rate-limit exceeded` repeated ~8 times then an exit 0 — suggests the canary retried quickly then recovered. not seeing backend CPU/GPU pressure.
Incident Bot: Alert auto-resolved after 75s (PD auto-resolve). tagging notif so we keep thread for follow-up.
Sophie: probably a duplicated cron or transient infra jitter causing the canary to backoff. recommend silencing PD for 30m while we validate and avoid noisy pages. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ava L: silencing PD for 30m now:
```
pd incidents silence PD12345 --duration 30m --reason "investigating transient canary flapping, no customer impact"
```
ops-bot: Silence applied (id: silence-8801) — will auto-expire in 30m.
Ravi P: quick root-cause hypothesis: new canary rollout had a duplicate schedule entry (cron overlap) causing two near-simultaneous runs, they briefly saturated the proxy's prefilling path. mitigation: remove duplicate cron, add jitter.
Jordan C: creating short ops ticket: OPS-412 — describe duplicate canary schedule + follow-ups (monitoring tweak, add jitter, confirm PD thresholds).
Ava L: leaving postmortem notes in OPS-412. handing off to afternoon oncall (Jordan) for follow-up and closure. good job, quick noise handle. :thumbsup:
Jordan C: got it, will close when OPS-412 done.
